notes: Benchtop LN2-vapour controlled-rate freezer, not a cryostat: a 630 x 510 x 550 mm box (39 kg) with a 297 x 317 x 378 mm, 36 L stainless-steel chamber under a hinged transparent glass lid (860 mm tall when open). Fed from a pressurised LN2 container (connector kit 16820/5100 included; catalog lists a 99 L TP100 tank and 60/120/189 L containers); vapour is stirred by a turbine fan and sensed by two 4-wire Pt-100s. Scene: translucent lid on top, racks of 0.25/0.5 mL straws standing in the chamber, LN2 vapour swirl animated, Pt-100 leads only. No vacuum, no magnet, no cold plates. Sources: leaflet 1682x-xxxx_leaflet-icecube_en_250905 V1 09/2025 (research/v5/cache/2cc09895ebb94ef8.txt) and catalog page p1826 (research/v5/cache/9297e2b381e0856a.txt).
